date_scope_check.qualification_retained:
NAN and contemporary Nigerian local reporting quote the customs controller describing the Nigerian reopening decision and actual February 9, 2026 truck clearance; NAN also quotes a Niger representative welcoming that decision. Anadolu independently attributes the months-long measure to Nigeria. This supports recording Nigerian involvement, rather than treating it as solely Niger-imposed.

Banouto attributes the preceding blockage to Niger while describing the Nigerian reopening. Its disagreement remains visible; separate concurrent measures may have been conflated. No original closure order or precise onset was recovered. Officials’ descriptions of months of disruption establish a >24-hour restriction, but neither the three-month shorthand nor broad seven-year retrospective accounts establish an exact continuous interval. The 2019 trade regime, 2022 Kamba permission and direct Benin–Niger frontier restriction remain separate.
date_scope_check.review_limit: No dates, unknown reopenings, duration classifications or continuity assumptions changed by this geographic review.
